extraction.pages_processed: 1-21 (all slides read; slides 10 and 14 are images read by text recognition)
extraction.notes: All 21 slides read. Slides 10 and 14 are images read by text recognition and are garbled; they hold no claim that could be quoted reliably (slide 14 is a screenshot of date.gov.md). Slides 8 and 9 (a diagram of institutions before and after MConnect), 17 (a technical diagram naming MPass and MConnect) and 18 to 20 (the title "GDP case study: Notary Chamber" only) carry no extractable claim. This run's items: MDA-GOV-2020-001-0012 to MDA-GOV-2020-001-0035 (24 items, all theme; TECH-INTEROP mainly, with TECH-DATA, TECH-DGOV and one TECH-CYBER). Alpha items 0001 to 0011 are unchanged; their passages are quoted again here. Left out: slide 2 (the chain "Data -> Informations -> ...", a lead-in to three strategic dimensions of data use, and "Acceleraring the use of digital tools and solutions": general, no claim of its own); slide 6 (the five data exchange pillars as single words, set out in full in MDA-GOV-2024-003); slide 11 (benefits as single words); slide 12 (a list of access channels under the heading "Needs for a single data portal"); the further bullets of slides 15 and 16. Self-reported by the agency, 6 July 2020; slides hosted by the World Bank do not make them World Bank findings. Doubtful for the analyst: the MConnect security feature (theme_doubtful). No Chapter 2 content. Second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-HELD8 on 5 November 2026: 3 items added (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MDA-GOV-2020-001.csv).
